claim_summary: In a summary of Saturday's events, southern correspondent Ariel Idan told viewers, 'Thank God, there were no bodily casualties.'
discovery_sources: The Seventh Eye 2023-10-14; Ynet 2023-10-14; Jerusalem Post 2023-10-14
resolution_notes: False. Ynet reports five people wounded by a mortar strike in Nirim that day, citing MDA director Eli Bin; Jerusalem Post independently reports multiple Nirim casualties. The Seventh Eye contemporaneously preserves Idan's exact Channel 14 wording and a broadcast screenshot. Claim is attributed specifically to Channel 14 reporter Ariel Idan, not to editorial speech generally. Contemporary reports differ between four and five wounded; either directly contradicts the categorical no-bodily-casualties claim.
media_status: Exact Channel 14 screenshot preserved in The Seventh Eye article; closest original clip/direct asset not recovered; stable GitHub preview pending; no substitute imagery used.
